4 Korean sunscreens worth a spot in your Olive Young cart ☀️ (Not sponsored)

1️⃣ ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Sunscreen — feels like a moisturizer
2️⃣ goodal Heartleaf Calming Moisture Sun Cream — sits well under makeup
3️⃣ SHINGMULNARA Light Watery Sun Gel — light gel texture
4️⃣ ETUDE Sebum Soak Mineral Filter Sun Cream — for when chemical filters don't suit you

Sun sticks? Great for touch-ups, but they don't replace your morning layer. Outdoors, reapply about every 2 hours, and sooner after sweating or swimming.

My rule: the best sunscreen is the one whose texture you'll actually wear every single day.
